title: Append-only correction of the due-ness stated for five cases in record 0013

correctionToRecord0013.why: Record 0013 read the outcome of a single isolated run and recorded 'executes and passes in isolation against the pinned fixture'. That is true and it is not sufficient: none of the five asserts anything, so none could carry coverage even if it ran green. Two of them sleep 30 and 60 seconds waiting for a human and three configure no host on purpose, so they cannot address the run-scoped fixture at all.
correctionToRecord0013.note: Record 0017 already applied the better classification, in its manualProfile section, but did not mark it as a correction of record 0013. Two records therefore stated opposite due-ness for the same five cases and neither pointed at the other. This entry is that missing pointer. Records 0013 and 0017 themselves are unchanged; the procedure is the one record 0013 used for its own correction of record 0011.
